A.input: independently validated FE/RU, target and cycles

C.invalid_reason: independent labels and causal validation missing; no composite index frozen

S.input: candidate angular speed per FE/RU submovement
S.formula: spectral arc length, normalized FFT magnitude >=0.05, <=10 Hz
S.invalid_reason: candidate angles unvalidated; static/incomplete/gapped segments excluded

Q.input: all saved capture frames, including unanalysed frames
Q.formula: frames with all three body points valid / saved capture frames
Q.supplements: largest invalid gap includes capture gaps and trial boundaries; queue drop counts separate

angles.assumption: fixed neutral palm normal; unobserved forearm axial rotation

timing.host_receive_to_output_ms: host monotonic output minus host frame receipt; does not establish device end-to-end latency
